bottom_line: OH0252700 should use a custom Ohio State Columbus footprint built from the official current OSU campus-map Buildings and Parking layers, anchored to the map-maintained Columbus Contiguous building geography and expanded only enough to recover the primary east/west academic campus land masses and immediately adjacent public-property edges. Remote Franklin Satellite / golf / off-campus lots stay out.

primary_geometry_source.why_this_is_primary: This is the current official geometry stack behind the public OSU campus map. Its Buildings layer already distinguishes Columbus Contiguous from Franklin Satellite and Golf Course geography, which is the strongest direct official line for primary-campus inclusion versus remote sites.

Sub-acre sliver components produced only by tiny support structures or a stray 17th-Avenue satellite remnant
Columbus place proxy, Franklin County proxy, University District joint-patrol geography, and generic Clery noncampus geography

build_method.seed_rule: Use official Buildings polygons where Geography equals Columbus Contiguous, drop obvious tiny shelter / utility pseudo-buildings from the seed set, and add official Parking polygons within 250 m of the contiguous-building union after removing explicit off-campus school lots.
build_method.why_250m_for_parking_is_defensible: A 250 m attachment rule keeps the official Carmack, Buckeye, Riverbank, Waterman-adjacent, and other west-campus / athletics / medical parking surfaces that support the contiguous campus while still cleanly excluding the clearly separate Indianola off-campus parking cluster more than 600 m away.
build_method.why_120m_is_defensible: Across tested closing distances from 20 m to 150 m, 120 m was the first threshold that reliably knit the official east-of-river academic/residential core, campus medical complex, west-of-river athletics, Kenny/Kinnear service corridor, Carmack / Buckeye reservoirs, and Waterman / west-campus structure into one primary campus mass without re-admitting Franklin Satellite buildings or the explicit off-campus parking cluster. Smaller distances left major mapped west-campus structure fragmented; larger distances mainly added extra smoothing area rather than resolving a doctrinal gap.
build_method.final_component_rule: Retain all resulting morphology-closed components at least 1 acre in size; drop sub-acre support slivers.
